entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Guinea-Bissau.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después de tu fecha de llegada a Guinea-Bisáu.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You must have a visa to visit Guinea-Bissau.
entry.es: Debes tener un visado para visitar Guinea-Bisáu.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to visit Guinea-Bissau.

entry.en: You must have a certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination to enter Guinea-Bissau.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado que acredite la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla para entrar en Guinea-Bisáu.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debes declarar cualquier cosa que pueda estar prohibida o sujeta a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: The text says visa on arrival has been possible as of 2024, though rules are unclear because of the lack of official information.
entry.es: El texto indica que desde 2024 es posible obtener el visado a la llegada, aunque las reglas no están claras por la falta de información oficial.
entry.quote: As of 2024, visa on arrival is possible, though the lack of official information on a website makes it difficult to know the rules around this.

safety.en: Pickpocketing and bag and phone snatching are relatively common in Bissau.
safety.es: Los hurtos y los robos de bolsos y teléfonos son relativamente comunes en Bissau.
safety.quote: Pickpocketing and bag and phone snatching are relatively common in the capital city, Bissau.

safety.en: Guinea-Bissau suffers from political instability, and travellers should avoid demonstrations or large public gatherings.
safety.es: Guinea-Bisáu sufre inestabilidad política y se debe evitar manifestaciones o grandes concentraciones.

safety.en: Landmines remain a risk in parts of the country, and demining operations continue.
safety.es: Las minas terrestres siguen siendo un riesgo en partes del país y continúan las labores de desminado.
safety.quote: Landmines remain a risk in parts of the country, and demining operations continue.

safety.en: Outside Bissau, travellers should take local advice and stay on paved roads because of landmines.
safety.es: Fuera de Bissau, se aconseja seguir el consejo local y circular por carreteras asfaltadas por las minas.
safety.quote: Outside of Bissau, take local advice and stay on paved roads.

safety.en: Road conditions and driving standards are poor, and road travel at night should be avoided.
safety.es: Las condiciones de las carreteras y la conducción son malas, y se debe evitar viajar por carretera de noche.
safety.quote: driving standards and road conditions, including in Bissau, are poor. Avoid road travel at night

safety.en: Same-sex couples showing affection in public may attract unwanted and negative attention.
safety.es: Las parejas del mismo sexo que muestren afecto en público pueden atraer atención no deseada y negativa.
safety.quote: same-sex couples showing affection in public may attract unwanted and negative attention.

health.en: Medical facilities are extremely limited and hospitals are not fully operational.
health.es: Los centros médicos son extremadamente limitados y los hospitales no funcionan plenamente.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Guinea-Bissau are extremely limited and hospitals are not fully operational.

health.en: Pharmacies are limited and may sometimes lack supplies.
health.es: Las farmacias son limitadas y a veces pueden carecer de suministros.
health.quote: Pharmacies in Guinea-Bissau are limited and may sometimes lack supplies.

health.en: Health risks include dengue, Zika virus, yellow fever, schistosomiasis and malaria.
health.es: Los riesgos sanitarios incluyen dengue, zika, fiebre amarilla, esquistosomiasis y malaria.
health.quote:
- dengue

- Zika virus

- yellow fever

- schistosomiasis

- malaria

health.en: The text recommends drinking only bottled or filtered water.
health.es: El texto recomienda beber solo agua embotellada o filtrada.
health.quote: Make sure you drink only bottled/filtered water.

health.en: The text says to have yellow fever, hepatitis A, tetanus and typhoid vaccinations up to date, and highly recommends malaria prophylaxis.
health.es: El texto indica tener al día las vacunas de fiebre amarilla, hepatitis A, tétanos y tifoidea, y recomienda mucho la profilaxis antipalúdica.
health.quote: make sure you have the yellow fever, hepatitis A, tetanus and typhoid vaccinations up to date. Malaria prophylaxis is highly recommended

help.en: The emergency number for an ambulance is 1313.
help.es: El número de emergencias para una ambulancia es el 1313.
El número de emergencias de la policía es el 117.

getting_in.en: Bissau-Bissalanca airport is the only international airport in the country.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Bissau-Bissalanca es el único aeropuerto internacional del país.
getting_in.quote: Bissau-Bissalanca airport is the only international airport in the country.

getting_in.en: There are buses and minibuses to Bissau from Senegal, Gambia and Guinea.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses y minibuses a Bissau desde Senegal, Gambia y Guinea.
getting_in.quote: There are buses and minibuses from Senegal (Ziguinchor, Dakar and Tambacounda), Gambia (Serekunda and Banjul), and Guinea (Conakry) to Bissau.

getting_in.en: The border with Senegal is closed after sunset.
getting_in.es: La frontera con Senegal está cerrada después del atardecer.
getting_in.quote: After sunset, the border with Senegal is closed.

getting_in.en: There is a sea route between Dakar and Bissau.
getting_in.es: Hay una ruta marítima entre Dakar y Bissau.
getting_in.quote: There is a sea route between Dakar and Bissau.

getting_around.en: Within Bissau, minibuses called toca-toca and regular taxis operate.
getting_around.es: En Bissau circulan minibuses llamados toca-toca y taxis normales.
getting_around.quote: In Bissau minibuses called toca-toca work for transports within the city. There are also regular taxis.

getting_around.en: For inter-city travel there are sept-places and candongas, and sept-place is preferred.
getting_around.es: Para viajes entre ciudades hay sept-places y candongas, y se prefiere el sept-place.
getting_around.quote: For inter-city travel there are sept-places, (seven-seat Peugeot) and candongas, big commercial vehicles carrying ten to twenty passengers.

getting_around.en: There are no time-schedules for cars, which leave when they are full.
getting_around.es: Los coches no tienen horarios y salen cuando se llenan.
getting_around.quote: There are no time-schedules; cars leave when they are full.

getting_around.en: Ferry schedules to the islands depend on tides and weather conditions, so check in advance.
getting_around.es: Los horarios de los ferris a las islas dependen de las mareas y el clima, así que conviene consultarlos antes.
getting_around.quote: Schedules depend on tides and weather conditions, so check in advance.

getting_around.en: Pirogues to the islands are cheap but rather unsafe.
getting_around.es: Las piraguas a las islas son baratas pero bastante inseguras.

money.en: Guinea-Bissau uses the West African CFA franc (XOF).
money.es: Guinea-Bisáu usa el franco CFA de África Occidental (XOF).
money.quote: The West African CFA franc (XOF) is used by Guinea-Bissau.

money.en: Guinea-Bissau is a cash-based economy where credit cards are rarely used and there are not many ATMs.
money.es: Guinea-Bisáu es una economía basada en efectivo, con pocas tarjetas de crédito y pocos cajeros.
money.quote: Guinea-Bissau is a cash-based economy. Credit cards are rarely used and there are not many ATMs in the country.

money.en: Ecobank has ATMs in Bissau that take Mastercard and Visa for cash withdrawal.
money.es: Ecobank tiene cajeros en Bissau que aceptan Mastercard y Visa para retirar efectivo.
money.quote: Ecobank has ATMs in Bissau which take Mastercard and Visa card for cash withdrawal.

money.en: If you need to exchange foreign currency, an official bureau de change should be used.
money.es: Si necesitas cambiar divisas, se debe usar una casa de cambio oficial.
money.quote: If you need to exchange foreign currency, use an official bureau de change.

money.en: The CFA franc is pegged to the euro at 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.
money.es: El franco CFA está vinculado al euro a 1 euro = 655,957 francos CFA.
money.quote: are pegged to the euro at 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.

etiquette.en: The text says to always ask in advance before taking photos, especially close-ups, as some people get upset.
etiquette.es: El texto indica que siempre se debe pedir permiso antes de hacer fotos, sobre todo primeros planos, porque algunas personas se molestan.
etiquette.quote: always ask in advance, especially taking close-ups.

etiquette.en: The text advises avoiding photos of military installations without asking.
etiquette.es: El texto aconseja evitar fotografiar instalaciones militares sin preguntar.
etiquette.quote: Avoid taking photos of military installations without asking, though sometimes you'll be allowed to.

etiquette.en: The text says visitors are often invited to eat with a group, commonly from a large bowl.
etiquette.es: El texto indica que a menudo invitan a los visitantes a comer en grupo, comúnmente de un gran cuenco.
etiquette.quote: you will always be asked to come eat with a group of people (it is common to eat from a large bowl)

connectivity.en: There are three mobile companies, all with prepaid cards sold in many places.
connectivity.es: Hay tres compañías móviles, todas con tarjetas de prepago que se venden en muchos sitios.
connectivity.quote: There are three mobile companies in Guinea Bissau all with prepaid mobile cards, that can be bought all over.

connectivity.en: There are numerous internet cafés in the centre of Bissau.
connectivity.es: Hay numerosos cibercafés en el centro de Bissau.
connectivity.quote: There are numerous internet cafés in the center of Bissau
